seo.description: Distinguish custody, access, accounting and market value. Informational preparation confirms neither an operation's legal status, returns nor an insurance product.

author: ING Broker editorial team
content:
The question “Can cryptoassets be insured?” has no reliable answer without a description of the activity, holder and actual risk. Lost access, accounting errors, contractual claims and falling market values are different situations. A Moldovan company should check activity status and possible insurance assessment separately.

This material is information, not investment advice, buying guidance or confirmation of legality. It does not state Insurance ING Broker SRL brokers cryptoasset cover. It requests no private keys, recovery phrases, passwords or wallet access. Never transmit these through a form or commercial discussion.

What to clarify before assessment

Describe the role: holding own assets, developing software, maintaining records for another entity or another relationship. Do not use the word “custody” without explaining what it means in the company's own documents. Technical services and safekeeping duties can raise different questions.

Record the legal entity, actual service and relevant countries in general terms. The initial summary does not require individual customer information. Specialists must verify authorisation or requirements from current official sources. A working application or partner's terminology is not sufficient legal evidence.

Why sources and dates matter

An old warning, project announcement and effective law have different purposes. The Moldovan Government's announcement of 22 July 2026 about a cryptoasset framework describes a draft proposal. Its existence alone does not confirm adoption and commencement of all described rules.

For a decision, identify the applicable act, version and date. This article gives no current legal conclusion about an operation. Keep public information, proposed rules and rules actually applicable to the activity distinct. Missing information must remain unconfirmed rather than being filled with assumptions.

Assets, access and records are different

An application balance does not alone explain legal ownership. Identify the documents explaining who holds the asset and which service is used, without copying access information. Separate accounting, contractual rights and technical access.

Do not demonstrate control by sending secrets. An assessor can specify necessary non-sensitive documents and channels. This article recommends no method for signing transactions, transferring assets or technically recovering access. It does not replace specialist assistance.

A working summary can identify a document, its date and the fact it is intended to support without reproducing access credentials. An internal accounting extract and a supplier agreement answer different questions. One may describe the asset the company records, while the other describes a service relationship. Neither should silently replace the other. A balance displayed in an application does not, on its own, establish who holds the asset or controls its movement.

A price fall is not an incident

Market movement differs from an alleged loss caused by an act or error. The difference between two market quotations is not automatically an insured loss. Record date, source and currency, separating assumptions from actual operations.

This article offers no forecasts, returns or buying suggestions. If competent people assess an insurance contract, the question concerns the exact event and insured property or activity. It is not an expectation that every fall in value can be recovered. Asset names and digital records do not establish value protection.

Read supplier relationships in documents

Keep contracts, accepted terms and changes with version dates. Identify the contracting entity, not just an application brand. Several supplier companies may have different services. Assess the actual agreement without importing another jurisdiction's rules.

Obtain legal advice for custody, liability, jurisdiction and debt recovery. Advertising does not guarantee funds or compensation. Check commercial statements against the actual documents and relevant status. Anything not confirmed must remain explicitly unconfirmed.

Cyber risk does not explain every discrepancy

Display errors, accounting problems and unauthorised access may initially look similar. Record observations without immediately determining cause. Competent teams assess technology and contracts. Do not publish identifiers, client balances, authentication or vulnerability details.

Separate own loss, customer claims and response costs. These can need different records and conditions. Cyber insurance for another activity does not establish cryptoasset operations are included. Check declared activities and exclusions.

The first file can contain no secrets

Prepare a description of the service, legal entity, contractual roles and types of documents available. For known incidents, record observation, communications and assessment stage without operational access. Categories can be described without unnecessary addresses or identifiers.

Agree sender and recipient. Never include recovery phrases in files, images or messages, even as working examples. Ask why additional data is needed and the channel. File organisation should create no new confidentiality or security risk.

Document values without rushed conclusions

Keep the source and recorded time for internal amounts. Distinguish invested sums, displayed value, transaction cost and claimed amount. Do not automatically add them or select a favourable moment as confirmed loss. A relevant specialist explains the method.

A contractual limit does not establish that every asset or every cause is accepted. Ask about valuation and records without assuming a universal digital asset basis. This article confirms no Moldovan prices, limits or eligibility.

Where teams use different labels for the same operation, prepare a mapping and preserve the original records. Do not rewrite a transaction history to make an insurance explanation appear stronger. Mark the discrepancy and identify the person responsible for checking it. A technical display error, a delay and an actual loss are not interchangeable conclusions. This article cannot determine a cause or establish ownership from a screenshot.

Example of separating a problem

A software company receives a complaint that interface information differs from a partner's records. Before calling it a loss, it checks delivered service, active version and documents. It does not request customer secrets or execute transfers to prove a theory.

This hypothetical scenario is not a real incident or coverage confirmation. It distinguishes professional service questions from asset value. Technical, legal and insurance conclusions use common facts but are not interchangeable.

Checking a commercial proposal

If someone presents “crypto insurance”, request the contracting entity and documents defining subject, activities and accepted risks. Read limits, deductibles, exclusions and notification. Do not rely solely on a logo, partner certificate or security statement.

Check whether the user, operator or another entity is concerned and for which period. A supplier contract does not automatically give every customer direct payment rights. Obtain legal assessment. This article confirms no particular proposal's authenticity or validity.

Questions to prepare responsibly

Start with verifiable role, service, documents and actual issue. Keep authorisation, accounting, security and insurance questions separate, identifying an appropriate specialist for each. Mark missing evidence unconfirmed rather than calling an assumption a commercial benefit.

ING Broker is a broker. It guarantees neither cryptoasset values, platform function nor access recovery. This article is not an offer or proof of availability. Any subsequent commercial communication requires separate confirmation of the actual activity, eligibility and conditions.

Operations and accounting documents

Explain internal figures using records and periods without account access. Seek competent accounting and tax support. The article establishes no accounting entries, taxes or reporting duties and recommends no accounting valuation method.

Distinguish completed operations from unexecuted intentions. Cancelled orders, displayed amounts and records may differ. Mark discrepancies for checking. One favourable screenshot or digital file does not validate its contents.

Agree the recipient and secure format before sharing supporting material. An initial description can explain the type of discrepancy without wallet addresses, customer identifiers or operational access details. Never send a recovery phrase or transfer assets merely to demonstrate a problem. In the final working table, separate the established fact, source, date and unresolved question. This improves the quality of the discussion but does not establish a valuation, regulatory status or insurable loss.

Stop unsuitable information before sending

Check for secrets, others' data or unnecessary details. Do not circulate an entire record for a general opinion. Request an acceptable summary and channel. Insurance enquiries justify neither technical access nor executing transactions.

Keep a record of who answered, the service concerned and the documents supporting the explanation. Another entity's or period's answer does not validate your situation. This is useful whether insurance discussion proves possible or not.

Frequently asked questions about cryptoassets

Is this investment advice?

No. It concerns risk boundaries and documents. It recommends no asset, platform, operation, strategy, forecast or return.

Does cyber insurance automatically protect cryptoassets?

No such conclusion follows. Check declared activity, subject and exclusions. Another service policy does not establish inclusion of digital assets or price movements.

Should I send a key or recovery phrase?

No. Never send passwords, private keys, recovery phrases or wallet access. Begin with a non-sensitive role and document description.

Is a Government project already applicable law?

A project announcement is not sufficient evidence of commencement. Verify actual status and application separately through current official sources and competent support.
